added.summary: A node header that holds the conversation on entering each node that has it (DialogueView.held) until og.story.advance runs the node, so another module can pace a story by node; logic nodes without the header run through. Saves keep the hold (story save version 9; older saves still load).
Every hashtag of a choice by name (`#hotspot:knife` is `{ hotspot: "knife" }`), for the game to read.

A loaded dialogue's nodes with their headers and choices, and every node each choice and each node's own steps may jump to: for a flowchart, a test that walks every route, or warming the segments a choice may lead to.
A dialogue node may carry `og-film`, `og-film-chapter` and `og-film-ending` (read by og.film); other `og-` headers still need an `og-topic` bark node.
